title: Nested array attributes are not highlighted
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

I recently swittched from react instantsearch to hooks in hopes of getting rid of the exact issue mentioned here:
https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/issues/2688

In short, attributes that are given as nested arrays in the Highlight widget do not get highlighted.

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

Add a highlight widget to your app like so:

```
    <Highlight hit={hit} attribute="hierarchy.lvl1" />
```

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/s/nostalgic-diffie-2q54y3

### 💭 Expected behavior

All attributes should get highlighted, even if they are nested arrays.

### Package version

react-instantsearch-hooks-web@6.47.3
